columns.validationmsg: "Expiry should be greater than today's date"
columns.name: expiry

columns.validationmsg: "Please enter valid value for Total Pieces"
columns.name: totalpieces

table.retrieve:
SELECT
	customicode=item.customicode,
	alternatecustomicode=prdetail.alternatecustomicode,   
	name=item.name, 
	itemdescription=prdetail.itemdescription,
	currlistrow = 0,
	packingdesc=item.packingdesc,
	prinvcode=prdetail.prinvcode,   
	icode=prdetail.icode,
	batch=prdetail.batch,
	expiry=prdetail.expiry,
	gcode=prdetail.gcode,
	packqty=prdetail.packqty,   
	looseqty=prdetail.looseqty,   
	bonusqty=prdetail.bonusqty,   
	packunits=prdetail.packunits,   
	TotalPieces=prdetail.TotalPieces,
	PiecesInHand=prdetail.PiecesInHand,
	prprice=prdetail.prprice,   
	avgprice=prdetail.avgprice,  
	packsaleprice=prdetail.packsaleprice,
	prutn=prdetail.prutn,
	retablelooseqty=0.0000,
	prevretlooseqty=0.0000, 	 
	retablebonusqty=0.0000,
	prevretbonusqty=0.0000,  
	stock=0.0000, 
	totalstock=0.0000,
	temp_packqty=0,
	itemtotalval=space(30),
	unitsalestax=prdetail.unitsalestax,
	gstperc=prdetail.gstperc, 
	PrRowId=prdetail.PrRowId,
	ManfCode = Item.ManfCode,
	PackCapacity = item.PackCapacity,
	AreaVolume = item.AreaVolume,
	PCS=ROUND(prdetail.looseqty / CASE WHEN item.AreaVolume > 0 THEN item.AreaVolume ELSE 1 END, 6),
	Cartons= LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(CAST(((ROUND(prdetail.looseqty / CASE WHEN item.AreaVolume > 0 THEN item.AreaVolume ELSE 1 END, 6)) / CASE WHEN item.PackCapacity > 0 THEN item.PackCapacity ELSE 1 END) AS INT), 7, 0))) + ' : ' +
		LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(((CAST(ROUND(prdetail.looseqty / CASE WHEN item.AreaVolume > 0 THEN item.AreaVolume ELSE 1 END, 6) AS INT)) % CAST(CASE WHEN item.PackCapacity > 0 THEN item.PackCapacity ELSE 1 END AS INT)), 7, 0))),
	discperc=prdetail.discperc
FROM 
	crs_prdetail prdetail, item
WHERE 
	( prdetail.clientinstanceid = :r_clientinstanceid ) and
	(prdetail.prinvcode = :r_InvCode)   and  
	( prdetail.icode = item.icode )
ORDER By PrRowid

objects.name: d_detaildwtotal
objects.expression: sum((( prprice  *  packqty ) + ( prprice  *  looseqty  )) *  ( 1 -  discperc  * .01 )  )
